sources.title: Pyrex-8B-Instruct-Uncensored — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: Pyrex-8B-Instruct-Uncensored is a abliterated and uncensored variant of BlossomsAI/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-Uncensored, published on Hugging Face by ImposterOnline. It is 8B parameters, single consumer GPU class and apache-2.0 licence. It is distributed across 5 repositories in GGUF and GGUF (imatrix) formats, totalling 5.9K downloads.
